reasoning_content:
Let me build the addon API using the documented local wheels workaround. I'll create a temp context that copies data-structures into the addon context and modifies the Dockerfile.

Actually, the addon build context is `02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds`. The Dockerfile uses `COPY ./api/...`. Dependencies: demospipes-data-structures (at ../../../data-structures from api dir = demospipes/data-structures) and demospipes-addon-bmds-data-structures (at ../data_structures from api dir = addons/bmds/data_structures).

The final base image needs to be `demospipes-base-api` (which we built) or the addon bmds executors base. Let me build the addon api.

The guide says modify builder to build both packages as local wheels. Let me create the temp context.

action.command:
set -e
CTX=/tmp/addon_api
rm -rf $CTX && mkdir -p $CTX
cp -r /workspace/02-backend/demospipes/addons/bmds/. $CTX/
# copy shared data-structures into addon context (per guide)
cp -r /workspace/02-backend/demospipes/data-structures $CTX/data-structures
ls $CTX
cat $CTX/api/Dockerfile | grep -n "FROM\|pip wheel\|COPY"
